# BannerlordCoopCampaign v0.3.2 — Changelog

This version of the mod has been tested and works reliably with the following game and dedicated server versions:

* Client: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord v1.4.8, build 119303.
* Server: Mount & Blade II Dedicated Server v1.4.8, build 118999.

## Fixed

* Fixed bugs that could cause crashes during battles.
